name: Rabbah
line: Rabbah was the chief city of the Ammonites, east of the Jordan, and it is where David's army fought and the prophets said God would bring ruin.

moments.title: Og's iron bed
moments.text: Moses said that only Og, king of Bashan, had remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. His iron bed, about nine cubits (roughly 13 feet) long, was still in Rabbah of the Ammonites.

moments.title: Joab surrounds Rabbah
moments.text: In the spring, David sent Joab and the whole army of Israel to destroy the Ammonites and surround Rabbah. David stayed in Jerusalem.

moments.title: David captures the city
moments.text: Joab took the royal fortress and the water supply, then asked David to bring the rest of the troops. David came and captured Rabbah, and he took the king's gold crown and much plunder.

moments.title: Jeremiah's message
moments.text: The LORD said through Jeremiah that He would sound the battle cry against Rabbah. It would become a heap of ruins, and its villages would be burned.

moments.title: Ezekiel's message
moments.text: Because Ammon cheered when Israel was laid waste, the Lord GOD said He would make Rabbah a pasture for camels. Then they would know that He is the LORD.
